name: SprintView columns
description:
1. User reported that in kanban columns with many cards, the bottom cards and the pinned "New Task" footer overflowed the board and became unreachable, especially in the "Done" column.
2. I diagnosed the cause: `SprintBoardColumn.vue` used a hard-coded `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` that didn't match the real available height, inside an `overflow-y-hidden` canvas.
3. First fix made columns `self-stretch` with `flex-1 min-h-0`, which worked but forced all columns to full height even when empty.
4. User preferred content-growing columns that cap and scroll only when needed, so I revised the fix to keep `self-start`, add `max-h-full`, and make the card list `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`.
5. Only `SprintBoardColumn.vue` changed (two class edits); header and footer stay `shrink-0` so "New Task" is always visible, with no store, props, or drag-and-drop changes.

messages.content: @software_developer When there are many cards the bottom of the column and "new task" option is not accessible as they overflow the height. See attached image. Can't access "new task" in "Done" column

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements:** When a column contains many task cards, the column overflows the board height so the pinned footer ("New Task" button) and the bottom cards become unreachable — there is no way to scroll to them. **Root Cause:** - `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` constrains the board height and explicitly hides vertical overflow: `overflow-y-hidden`, with the inner flex row sized `h-full`. - `SprintBoardColumn.vue` opts **out** of the container height with `self-start`, so each column's height is driven by its **content** (header + cards + footer) instead of by the available space. - The card list tries to compensate with a hard-coded `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]`, but that arbitrary value can exceed the real available viewport, so the whole column grows past the canvas. Because the canvas is `overflow-y-hidden`, the footer ends up below the fold and is impossible to reach. **Strategic Approach:** Make each column a **definite-height, stretch** flex column so its internal regions behave predictably: - Header and footer stay `shrink-0` (always visible). - The card list becomes the only elastic region: `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`, so it scrolls internally instead of pushing the footer off-screen. - This removes the fragile `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` magic number. **Dependencies & Risks:** - Columns will now render at full board height (standard kanban behaviour). The footer is pinned to the bottom of each column instead of flowing right after the last card. - No store, props, emits, or drag-and-drop logic is touched. **Target Files:** - `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` (modify) --- ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach **File: `SprintBoardColumn.vue`** — two class-only changes: 1. Column root: `self-start` → `self-stretch` (stop opting out of the stretched height). 2. Card list: `overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` → `overflow-y-auto flex-1 min-h-0` (let it fill remaining space and scroll internally). No other file requires changes; the canvas already provides the bounded height (`flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden` + inner `h-full`). --- ## 3. File Changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` | Modify | Column root `
` | `self-start` → `self-stretch` so the column fills the board height instead of growing with its content. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` | Modify | Task list `
` | `overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` → `overflow-y-auto flex-1 min-h-0` so the cards area takes the remaining space and scrolls internally, keeping header and footer visible. | No changes required in `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` or `SprintBoardView.vue`. --- ## 4. Why this works (and an alternative) The column is now a **definite-height flex column**: ``` ┌──────────────┐ │ Header (shrink-0) │ ← always visible ├──────────────┤ │ Cards │ │ flex-1 │ ← scrolls internally │ min-h-0 │ ├──────────────┤ │ Footer (shrink-0) │ ← always visible / reachable └──────────────┘ ``` - `flex-1` makes the card list absorb all leftover vertical space. - `min-h-0` is essential — without it a flex child refuses to shrink below its content size, which is the browser default that caused the overflow. - The header/footer keep `shrink-0`, so they are never compressed and the "New Task" button is always on-screen. **Alternative (if you prefer content-height columns):** keep `self-start` and wrap the card list in a `max-h-full overflow-y-auto` inside a `max-h-full` column. This preserves "short column for few cards" but pins the footer **inside** the scroll region, so the footer scrolls away with the cards — less ideal for reachability. The stretch approach is preferred for a fixed-height kanban board. **Anti-patterns avoided:** - ❌ Relying on a hard-coded viewport calc (`calc(100vh-16rem)`) that breaks across headers/toolbars/responsive layouts. - ❌ Leaving the footer outside a bounded scroll container so it overflows an `overflow-hidden` ancestor. - ❌ Removing the footer from the flex flow entirely (e.g. `fixed`) which would break per-column alignment. **Accessibility checklist:** - ✅ The `New Task` button (primary per-column action) is now always keyboard-reachable and visible. - ✅ Internal scroll region remains a normal scrollable element reachable via Tab/arrow keys. - ✅ Drag-and-drop behaviour and drop targets are unchanged. - ✅ Touch targets (footer button) are unaffected and remain ≥ 44px tall on mobile.

The fix works, but makes all columns to fill whole height no matter if they have cards or not, I prefer like how it's now so column growths with cards until filling the space, then scrolls. The problem now is that the "new task" actions at the bottom are not computed and the bottom of the column overflows the container height

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **What you want is a "hybrid" column:** - Few cards → the column **shrinks to its content** (current nice behaviour). - Many cards → the column **caps at the available board height**, the card list starts scrolling internally, and the pinned header/footer stay visible. The previous fix forced every column to full height via `self-stretch`, which is why empty columns became tall. We only need to re-introduce a **ceiling**, not a fixed height. **Root Cause of the remaining overflow:** - `self-start` makes the column height content-driven (good) ✅ - But the card list caps itself with `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` — a magic viewport number that has **no idea of the real available space** left after the sprint header, toolbar and progress bar. When that calc is bigger than the actual board area, the whole column (cards + footer) spills past the container. - Because `SprintBoardCanvas` is `overflow-y-hidden`, the bottom of the column (footer included) is clipped and unreachable. **Strategy:** - Cap the **column** at the real available height with `max-h-full` (100% of the flex row, which itself is `h-full`), instead of guessing with `100vh`. - Make the **card list** the single elastic region: `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`, so it absorbs the leftover space and scrolls once the column is capped. - Keep header and footer `shrink-0` so they never get pushed out. **Dependencies / Risks:** - Content-only behaviour for short columns is preserved (`self-start` untouched). - No store, props, emits, or drag-and-drop changes. **Target file:** `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` only. --- ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach Two class-only edits in `SprintBoardColumn.vue`: 1. **Column root:** keep `self-start`, add `max-h-full` → content-height column, capped at the available board height. 2. **Card list:** replace `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` with `flex-1 min-h-0` → becomes the internal scroll region once the column hits its cap, and stays natural-sized while it doesn't. `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` already provides the bounded parent (`flex-1 min-h-0` + inner row `h-full`), so no change is needed there. --- ## 3. File Changes ```vue src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` | Modify | Column root `
` | Add `max-h-full` (keep `self-start`) so the column grows with its content but can never exceed the available board height. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue` | Modify | Task list `
` | Replace `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` with `flex-1 min-h-0` so the list becomes the elastic, internally-scrolling region once the column is capped. | No changes required in `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` or `SprintBoardView.vue`. --- ## 4. Why this works (and alternatives) **Resulting behaviour:** | Cards | Column height | Card list | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Few | Content-sized (shrinks, empty columns stay short) | Natural, no scrollbar | | Many | Capped at `max-h-full` (the real board area) | Takes remaining space, scrolls internally | - `self-start` keeps the column **content-driven** (your preferred short-column behaviour). - `max-h-full` clamps that growing height to 100% of the flex row, which is `h-full` — so the cap reflects the **actual available space**, not a guessed `100vh` number. - `flex-1 min-h-0` on the card list is what makes it the only element that gives up space. `min-h-0` is required: without it the browser's default `min-height: auto` refuses to let the scroll area shrink below its content, which is exactly what pushed the footer off-screen. - Header and footer keep `shrink-0`, so the bottom "New Task" button is always visible and reachable, even in the "Done" column with 14 cards. **Alternative (not chosen):** keeping the viewport calc but tuning the number. Rejected because it breaks whenever the header/toolbar/progress bar height changes (responsive, mobile, extra toolbars) — the cap would again drift and clip the footer. **Anti-patterns avoided:** - ❌ Hard-coded viewport math (`calc(100vh-16rem)`) that doesn't match the real container. - ❌ `h-full`/`self-stretch` on the column, which forces empty columns to full height. - ❌ Leaving the footer outside a bounded scroll region under an `overflow-y-hidden` ancestor. **Accessibility checklist:** - ✅ The per-column "New Task" action is always visible and keyboard-reachable. - ✅ Internal scroll area remains a standard scrollable element (Tab / arrow keys work). - ✅ Drag-and-drop and drop targets are untouched.

2. **Root cause:** `SprintBoardColumn.vue` used `self-start` (content-driven height) plus a fragile `max-h-[calc(100vh-16rem)]` on the card list, letting columns grow past the canvas.

3. **Fix:** Changed the column root to `self-stretch` so it fills the board height, and the card list to `flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto` so cards scroll internally.

4. **Result:** Header and footer stay `shrink-0` and always visible; only the cards area scrolls, keeping "New Task" reachable with no magic viewport numbers.

5. **Scope:** A single file (`src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardColumn.vue`), two class-only changes, touching no store, props, emits, or drag-and-drop logic.
